The '''[[Agrocite/Legends|Agrocite]] processing facility''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]]. During the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]], it changed hands several times: originally controlled by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces, it was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but later recaptured again in the Separatist counter-assault.
